title: Ludum Dare 30 Challenge (2012)
description: In 2012 I built a game called Bridge Captain for the 30-day Ludum Dare Challenge. The rules were to design, build, release, and sell a game within the month of October. I ended up selling 300 copies within a couple of days of launch. However, I pulled it off the store in order to complete the story mode.
